description_zh: ego（Cruise AV）在路口直行时，右侧相邻车道的车辆（v2）突然向左变道切入ego车道，导致两车侧面擦碰。天气晴朗，夜间有路灯。

source_snippets: a Cruise autonomous vehicle ... traveling westbound on Turk Street through the intersection with Steiner Street when another vehicle encroached into the Cruise AV's lane from the right adjacent lane and made contact with the right side of the Cruise AV
VEH 1 MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: PROCEEDING STRAIGHT
VEH 2 MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: CHANGING LANES
evidence.reason: 另一方车辆从相邻车道变道侵入ego车道造成侧面碰撞，属于典型的cut-in场景，无缺失原语。
